component.name: Audiobookshelf
component.summary: Client for an Audiobookshelf server, designed for mobile Linux

description.p: GNOME-native client for an Audiobookshelf media server, designed for mobile Linux (Phosh on the Librem 5, also usable on desktop).
Browse your library, stream or play downloaded audiobooks and podcasts, and keep listening progress in sync with the server. Integrates with the desktop via MPRIS2 and pauses during phone calls.
